info.name: Raise Hand API (HW3 · DRF)
info.description:
Live Q&A for lectures — Django REST Framework + PostgreSQL in Docker Compose.

Run the folders in order (or the whole collection with the Collection Runner / newman): folder 1 creates a lecture and stores its id/code in collection variables, folder 2 creates, edits and deletes a question in it, folder 3 adds topics (one-to-many) and a written answer (one-to-one), folder 4 deletes the lecture, folder 5 shows the error responses.

Variables: baseUrl (default http://localhost:8000), voter (identifies the upvoter), lecture_id / lecture_code / question_id / topic_id / tagged_question_id (filled automatically).

Docs: {{baseUrl}}/docs/ (Swagger UI), docs/API.md in the repository.
